text:
flo (events): Quick fun idea  casual 'Sunset Sketch & Sips' after work next Wed? Low-key: bring a sketchbook or just hang, sip, and do a 15-min draw prompt. Options for spot: 1) Riverwalk lawn (picnic + skyline), 2) Studio 3 (indoor with big tables), 3) Rooftop Garden (weather permitting). Start 6pm or 6:45? RSVP + whether you need a chair/table. :art: :cocktail:

noah: Love this. Riverwalk 6pm works best. I can bring a couple small cushions. Prefer outdoors. :sun_with_face:

anya: Studio 3 for me (less wind). 6:45 ok. vegetarian snack here (no nuts pls). :paintbrush:

devi n: (devin): Im in either. Can bring some markers and a roll of butcher paper for a collaborative doodle. 6pm preferred.

mar: tentative but probably will join for the rooftop if weathers good. happy to help carry blankets. :blanket:

flo (events): Nice split. Making a quick ops-bot poll to decide spot + start time. If Riverwalk wins Ill ask for a small permit spot and bring bug spray; if Rooftop wins Ill check cover; Studio 3 Ill reserve two big tables.

ops-bot: Poll: "Sunset Sketch & Sips - pick spot and time"  Riverwalk lawn  2 votes  6:00  Studio 3  2 votes  6:45  Rooftop Garden  1 vote  6:00 (ends in 18h)

anya: I can bring a small veg tray (no nuts) and some disposable cups.

noah: If Riverwalk wins Ill grab a bluetooth speaker and two battery lanterns.

flo (events): Awesome. Ill lock whatever wins by tomorrow noon and post final meetup + small reminder about supplies (sketch pads, pens, blankets). If you havent voted, react to ops-bot or drop a quick reply here. See you for a mellow creative hang! :sparkles:
